hints.title: Prefix Decomposition
hints.text: Define `cost[i]` as the minimum cost to construct the prefix `target[0..i-1]`. Base condition is `cost[0] = 0`.

hints.title: Word Cost Deduplication
hints.text: Multiple identical words can appear with different costs. Store only the minimum cost for each unique word string.

hints.title: Forward Transition
hints.text: For each reachable prefix index i, check each word as a candidate extension starting at i, relaxing dp[i + len(w)].

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear prefix progression testing string matching.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branch search explores exponential paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) DP array and word hash map.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models string synthesis as 1D dynamic programming.
